text:
Alex Chen: Hey @Mira — handing off TheraQ (mid-market health, POC started 2025-06-01). Quick context: they're on hosted API for now (chat + embeddings). Pilot metrics: ~150k tokens/week, ~12k embeddings, 3 routes. Onboarding status: Okta SSO in flight, network whitelist needed for dedicated later, data classification review pending. Renewal in ~9 months; flagging ~70% risk due to SSO delays + latency concerns.

Alex Chen: Main blockers: intermittent p99 spikes ~500-700ms on >2k-token prompts; customer has PHI plans and will ask for private VPC later. They want a product walkthrough + integration best-practices. Primary customer contacts: sara@theraq.com (CTO), diego@theraq.com (Platform).

Alex Chen: Hand-off checklist (quick):
```
- CS owner: Mira Patel (run kickoff + enablement)
- Support ticket: create for latency traces (Tom Rivers)
- Eng owner: Jana Horvath (routing/quantization review)
- Docs: SF opp + contract link (Alex)
- Follow-up: collect eval prompts, cost sensitivity notes, and SSO timeline
```

Mira Patel: Thanks Alex — taking CS lead. I'll schedule onboarding + a one-pager enablement. Can you drop the SF link and a sample prompt that reproduces latency?

Alex Chen: SF link: https://salesforce.company/opp/TheraQ-001 (internal). Sample prompt that spikes: "Summarize patient's last 12 months of multi-modal notes and produce action items for care team. Include timeline and flagged anomalies." — tends to hit long-context paths.

Tom Rivers: Creating support ticket SUP-4821 to triage latency/trace. Need KV-cache metrics, kernel selection logs, and the example prompt. @Jana can you glance at model routing options? I'll attach traces once telemetry is available.

Jana Horvath: On it. I'll review routing & recommend quant profiles. If they're targeting Dedicated/VPC, we should bench the preferred model variants with 2x batch sizes and test fallback policies. Will aim to have initial notes by EOD.

OnboardBot: Reminder — onboarding checklist assigned to Mira Patel. Due in 5 business days.

Mira Patel: Kicked off a calendar invite with Sara & Diego for 2025-03-30 10:00 PT. Creating a shared doc for feedback capture and a prompt-set for evals. Action: run evals against M-Base-7B and M-Align-13B as baseline.

Alex Chen: Customer feedback: very cost sensitive, prefers lower-cost model variants for non-sensitive workloads. Please ask Optimize team for batching + quant recommendations. Marking renewal risk at 70% but big upsell if latency & SSO are solved.

Tom Rivers: Support action: request read-only telemetry access and example logs from customer. Alex — can you ask Sara to enable a short telemetry window? I'll triage once access is granted and link SUP-4821 to the CS doc.

Mira Patel: I'll capture integration feedback in the shared doc during kickoff and send follow-up survey questions. Will also confirm owners for enablement items after the call. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Thanks all — cc'ing finance/contract owner in SF opp. I'll follow up with Sara for telemetry and contract clarifications.

Tom Rivers: Noted. Will update SUP-4821 with traces and next steps once we get telemetry.

Mira Patel: Added initial action items in the doc and tagged owners. Will post a short summary in this thread after kickoff.

Alex Chen: Appreciate it — leaving the thread to CS & Support.
